objective: Cerrar exclusivamente el hueco documental de Gate12M mediante certificacion READ_ONLY del estado ya integrado por CAVAS-GATE12M-PERSONA-LINK-E2E-CANARY-R2-20260918. No reejecutar el canario ni modificar codigo/SQL/datos. Verificar que la prueba canaria integrada sigue presente y conserva el contrato BOS Socio -> Gobierno_Persona, que la limpieza en finally evita residuos, que no existe matching automatico por nombre/email/telefono, que SocioID sigue siendo identidad de membresia, que Botellas/Cargos/Movimientos permanecen por SocioID, y que el estado fisico actual no muestra residuos de Persona/PersonaVinculo/socios vinculados atribuibles al canario. Produccion prohibida.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS db_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: cava_socios_link_state
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_sin_persona,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS socios_con_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: persona_state
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_personas FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_state
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_vinculos FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo;

queries.name: cava_persona_fk_state
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';

queries.name: child_socios_fk_state
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,fk.name AS fk_name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN (N'CavaSocios_Botellas',N'CavaSocios_Cargos',N'CavaSocios_Movimientos') AND pc.name=N'SocioID' AND rc.name=N'SocioID' ORDER BY child_table;

constraints: No automatic matching by NombreCompleto Email or Telefono
Botellas Cargos Movimientos remain linked by SocioID
